body:
## Fix

F1. Identical progressive-publish retries now verify immutable content files and manifest before returning idempotent. Missing objects are restored with conditional creation; divergent existing bytes remain rejected.
F2. Previous fast path checked only pointer/manifest, so missing content files stayed missing despite successful retry. Add fake-S3 regression deleting one immutable object, retrying, and verifying restoration.

## Validation

V1. Missing-object regression failed before fix, passes after fix.
V2. Parent reran producer/publisher suite: 48 tests passed, including publication ordering, conditional-write conflicts, immutable byte conflicts, and unchanged idempotent pointer.
V3. Parent inspected complete publisher, test fixture, and ADR-092 closure/immutability contract. No blocking finding.
V4. Worker typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.

## Limits

L1. No live R2 request or publication performed. Fake transport is not proof of live hosting; full repository/browser suites not run locally.
L2. Correctness trade-off: idempotent retries now read every immutable object with HEAD/GET. Large releases incur substantial extra read requests and transfer. No claim of performance improvement.
title: fix(delivery): restore missing objects on idempotent publish
